core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aarefa corresponds to the Arabic form عارفة and is glossed in this record as “Knowing, aware, learned.” The record associates the form with root ع ر ف (ʿ-r-f). The record identifies the form as feminine. The lexical gloss describes the word-form; Qur’anic occurrence, religious recommendation, popularity, and a name-bearer’s character are separate claims and are not established by this gloss alone.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aarefa represents Arabic عارفة (ʿārifah), the feminine form corresponding to عارف (ʿārif), associated with knowing, recognizing, or being aware. These are lexical senses and do not imply a person's knowledge, character, or religious standing.

persian.name: عارفه
persian.long_meaning: Aarefa (عارفه) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن دانا، آگاه، دانشمند است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आरिफ़ा
